instruction: Look at gui_018_motor_mount.step in SolidWorks, a motor mount with a 100 x 80 x 8 mm base plate from Z=0 to Z=8 and a centered top boss of diameter 50 mm and height 12 mm from Z=8 to Z=20. Cut a 22 mm through center hole through the boss. Add four motor mounting holes of diameter 5.5 mm through the base plate on radius 32 mm at angles 45, 135, 225, and 315 degrees. Add two obround base mounting slots through the base plate, each total length 24 mm along the Y direction and width 8 mm along the X direction, centered at X=+/-35 and Y=0. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_018_motor_mount_out.step. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
